name: Main Gate
description: The main entrance from the shuttle drop-off and car park. Opens at noon each day; bag checks take about ten minutes at peak times.

name: Beach Gate
description: Walk-in and bike entrance from the Halcyon Bay boardwalk. Free bike parking for 2,000 bikes.

name: Harbor Food Court
description: Twenty-two traders, from fish tacos to dal. Every trader has a vegan option and a dish under $12.

name: Night Market
description: Late-night street food, coffee and churros near the Kelp Forest. Open until 1 am.

name: Water refill: Tidepool
description: Free cold water. Bring an empty bottle or buy a festival bottle for $8.

name: Water refill: Dunes
description: Free cold water between the Driftwood Stage and the Kelp Forest.

name: First Aid
description: Staffed by paramedics from noon until an hour after the last set. Also a quiet welfare space.

name: Info and Lost Property
description: Questions, lost property, phone charging and the festival map in print.

name: Toilets: North
description: Including accessible toilets and baby changing.

name: Accessible Viewing Platform
description: Raised platform at the Tidepool Main Stage for wheelchair users and people who need a seat, with one companion each.

name: Lockers and Charging
description: Lockers big enough for a backpack, and phone charging. Book on the day at the Info tent.
